text:
carla_sales: Quick sync - prospect (global payments) requires 7-year retention for customer-managed keys and asked whether Redwood can: 1) be escrow holder, 2) provide SLA-backed unwraps during legal holds, or 3) accept wrapped backups with restore drills. They also want a ballpark price uplift. Anyone see blockers?

raj_sre: short: we will NOT hold plaintext KEKs. We can support BYOK and route unwraps to customer KMS. Dedicated/Private can take an unwrap SLA; hosted is constrained by external KMS uptime. We can store wrapped blobs (opaque ciphertext) but strict ops controls required.

hana_eng: tech details: wrapped-backup workflow feasible: customer supplies ciphertext blob (e.g., AWS KMS ciphertext, or CMS/PKCS#7). We store opaque blob, never decrypt. Retrieval flow: authenticated request -> approval -> deliver blob. Need format agreement, sample blob, and QPS expectations. Historical retention across rotations is doable but increases storage and bookkeeping.

marta_legal: legal: OK to store wrapped blobs but contract must state "Customer retains ownership and sole control of keying material." If Redwood acts as escrowee for wrapped blobs we need: limited-use clause, retrieval approval process, indemnity for compelled disclosures, and explicit prohibition on storing or accessing plaintext. We should refuse plaintext escrow except under heavily negotiated SOW with strict controls.

carla_sales: customer will push to have Redwood act as escrow for convenience. They asked for a price range now - can we provide a placeholder?

tony_product: feature framing: "Managed wrapped key backup" as enterprise add-on. Pricing model suggestion: one-time onboarding fee, annual compliance surcharge, per-GB encrypted storage, and per-retrieval fee (expedited retrieval extra). Until compliance sign-off, mark as "custom quote."

raj_sre: ops checklist if we accept: HSM-backed envelope encryption for stored blobs, immutable audit logs, strict RBAC (no one can decrypt), retrieval approval workflow (multi-signature), automated retention lifecycle, regular attestation reports, and retrieval drills. Also carveouts in SLA for customer KMS outages and legal processes.

hana_eng: integration questions to request from customer now: KMS vendor (AWS KMS/CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault, Thales), wrapped blob format (AWS ciphertext, PKCS#7, other), expected unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, whether they expect all historical rotated keys retained for 7yrs or only specific snapshots, and a sample wrapped blob for schema validation.

marta_legal: I'll draft contract snippets: (1) "Customer retains sole ownership of keys" (2) "Redwood may store wrapped key blobs only and will not possess plaintext" (3) "Retrievals performed only on Customer authorization following retrieval runbook" (4) "Carveout for customer KMS downtime and legal hold processes."

compliance_bot: reminder: run `/new-compliance-review managed-wrapped-backup <prospect-name> <scope:retention+retrieval>` before including pricing in SOW.

carla_sales: Proposed reply to customer: we do not store plaintext; we can offer wrapped-only managed backup as an enterprise add-on (custom quote, requires compliance review); unwrap SLA available for Dedicated/Private with carveouts; please provide KMS vendor, endpoints, unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, and a sample wrapped blob. I'll schedule a 30m scoping call.

tony_product: add acceptance criteria: pre-go-live rotation dry-run and a retrieval drill.

raj_sre: I'll prepare an ops appendix (design, RTO expectations, caching behavior, monitoring, and retrieval runbook).

hana_eng: I'll draft minimal integration test plan: `wrap/unwrap smoke`, `rotation dry-run`, `retrieval drill`, `audit-log verification` and required sample artifacts.

carla_sales: Scheduling scoping call for tomorrow 11am PT and will post notes here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
